jobs.description:
Are You Our Next Rescue Zookeeper at Odsherred Zoo Rescue?

We are looking for two qualified zookeepers with a passion for exotic animals and animal rescue!Fonden Odsherred Zoo Rescue is Denmark's first and only approved rescue centre for exotic animals in need. We provide a permanent home for animals that have experienced difficult circumstances and need specialised care.

We are currently looking for two dedicated, qualified zookeepers to join our team.

About the PositionsThe positions primarily involve caring for our larger animals and a variety of other species, including small wild cats, camels, meerkats, llamas, deer, birds and more.

Our rescue centre is home to approximately 600 animals, representing a wide range of exotic species.

You will work closely with our existing team of six zookeepers and a maintenance colleague. Teamwork is an essential part of our daily operations, and we expect everyone to contribute to a supportive and responsible working environment.

Both positions are full-time and include weekend duties approximately twice a month.

We are looking to fill:

• 
One longer-term position, potentially permanent or lasting 1–2 years.

• 
One shorter-term position, lasting approximately 6–12 months.

We would like the successful candidates to start as soon as possible.

What We Expect From You

We are looking for colleagues who are genuinely passionate about animal welfare and understand the responsibility that comes with working at a rescue centre.

You should be:

• 
A qualified zookeeper with experience or a strong interest in exotic animals.

• 
Reliable, punctual, honest and hardworking.

• 
Positive, adaptable and willing to take responsibility.

• 
A team player who actively supports and communicates with colleagues.

• 
Observant and attentive to the animals in your care, recognising changes in their health, behaviour and general well-being.

• 
Willing to learn and adapt to the different challenges of working with rescued animals.

• 
Comfortable with the practical and sometimes physically demanding nature of animal care.

Teamwork is particularly important to us. We have a working culture in which colleagues help one another complete the day's responsibilities. We expect everyone to contribute, communicate openly and take their responsibilities seriously.

Working at a rescue centre is more than a traditional zookeeping job. It requires dedication, flexibility and an understanding that the needs of rescued animals can be very different from those of animals in conventional zoological collections.

Visitor Presentations and Social Media For approximately half the year, our rescue centre is open to the public.

During this period, all zookeepers participate in educational presentations for visitors, introducing the animals they care for and explaining their stories, behaviour and needs.

Public speaking is a mandatory part of the position, but previous presentation experience is not required as long as you are willing to learn.

We also regularly produce content for our social media platforms to raise awareness of our rescue work and the animals in our care.

This includes livestreams, photographs and recorded videos. Our zookeepers participate in this work by helping communicate the stories of the animals and the daily life of our rescue centre.

Understanding Our Mission, Odsherred Zoo Rescue is built around three main areas of work:

1. Rescue and Rehabilitation — Our Primary Mission

First and foremost, we are a rescue centre for exotic animals in need.

Our animals come from a variety of backgrounds, including the pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries, confiscations, former private ownership and other zoological institutions across Denmark and Europe.

Many of these animals have experienced difficult circumstances and require specialised care, patience and understanding.

Providing them with a safe and permanent home is our highest priority.

2. Conservation and Breeding Programmes

When resources and funding allow, we participate in conservation breeding programmes for rare and endangered species, including tamarins from South America.

Although this is an important part of our work, it remains secondary to our primary rescue mission.

3. Providing Homes for Surplus Zoo Animals

When we have the necessary space and resources, we also welcome surplus animals from other zoological institutions, providing them with a home when they might otherwise face euthanasia.

A Different Approach to Zookeeping, We want to emphasise that working at Odsherred Zoo Rescue is not the same as working at a traditional zoo.

We welcome applicants with experience from conventional zoological institutions, but it is essential that you are open-minded and willing to understand the different principles and challenges involved in operating a rescue centre.

Our focus is not simply on maintaining a zoological collection. It is on providing individual animals with the care, security and permanent home they deserve.

We are looking for colleagues who genuinely share these values and are willing to learn, adapt and contribute to our mission.

How to Apply, If you are passionate about exotic animals, dedicated to animal welfare and would like to become part of our rescue team, we would love to hear from you.

Please send your written application and CV to: post@odsherreds-zoo.dk only written inquiries.

Yours sincerely

Joan Thygesen

Director and founder of

Found Odsherred Zoo Rescue

**

• Support the ongoing monitoring and analysis of portfolio performance across Flagship funds

• Maintain, update, and enhance portfolio models, dashboards, and reporting tools

• Prepare high‑quality materials for investment committees, senior management, and investor reporting

• Conduct financial analysis, scenario modelling, and forecasting to support strategic decision‑making

• Track key performance indicators, market trends, and asset‑level developments

• Identify risks and opportunities within the portfolio and support follow‑up actions

• Collaborate closely with investment teams, asset managers, and other internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with fund strategy

• Assist in preparing portfolio reviews, valuation updates, and fund‑level presentations

**

• Excellent analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with a high level of attention to detail

• Proficiency in Excel; experience with BI tools or data analytics is a plus

• Comfortable working with large datasets and multiple information sources

• Helping develop in-house tools, such as techno-economic calculation models, to support concept design and benchmarking of PtX and BtX projects

• Coordinating across project disciplines and stakeholders

• Managing third-party verification

• Contributing to knowledge sharing and smooth project delivery

You will work from our office in Copenhagen (Tromsøgade 2, Nordhavn) or Aalborg HQ (John F. Kennedys Plads 43). Because we work globally, the role sometimes calls for flexibility, and we offer the same in return.

**About you

**You are curious and enjoy learning. You like working in a structured, thoughtful way, and you thrive in an international, multicultural environment where adaptability and teamwork matter.

We are looking for someone who brings:

• An MSc in chemical engineering or another relevant engineering field

• Around 10 years of experience with chemical processes

• Strong process experience, including PFDs, process modeling tools (e.g., Aspen HYSYS, DWSIM), equipment design, P&IDs, and process safety

• A solid understanding of thermodynamics, reaction engineering, fluid flow, heat transfer, and mass transfer

• Hands-on experience with one or more PtX or BtX production processes, such as electrolysis, steam methane reforming (SMR), Haber-Bosch, methanol synthesis, methanation, synthesis of higher hydrocarbons (SAF), refinery processes, biomass processing, carbon capture, or CO2 sequestration

• Good collaboration and organizational skills

• Fluent written and spoken English

**Contact

**For more information about the position, please contact Anne Krog Jensen, Head of PtX & Molecules, at akj@bluepp.dk.

To apply, upload your resume through our recruitment system via the “Apply” link. We don’t accept applications by email.

**Why join Blue Power Partners?

**At Blue Power Partners, we value belonging, purpose, and diverse perspectives, and we believe they contribute to our innovation and long-term success. Our organization is built on trust, entrepreneurship, and balance. You will join a focused team working on specialized technical projects, where you can grow your expertise in PtX and BtX. Joining BPP means becoming part of a consultancy that is contributing to the energy transition, with strong technical roots and an international scope.

jobs.description:
Meet your team

[

Devoteam always offers you new opportunities to make you learn, expand your knowledge and evolve in your career path

Discover Layal’s story

](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OUqqJ_5rdl0&feature=youtu.be)

Job Description

Strategy & Digital Business Design is the Copenhagen strategy team inside Devoteam, a company of more than 11,000 tech professionals, around 350 of them here in Denmark.

Most companies by now have more AI ideas, pilots and PoCs than they know what to do with. We help them focus on the few problem spaces that matter, and we stay until the solutions create real value in the business.

We’re hiring one or more Lead Strategy Consultants. It’s a senior role. You run your own workstreams, you lead other consultants on them, and you’re comfortable in a room with the client’s leadership team without someone more senior next to you.

The work:

Most of our engagements start with a question like “where should we place our AI bets, and what are they worth?” From there, you’ll do AI strategy and readiness work with business leaders, shape the first use cases and pilot teams, and make sure the solutions make it past the PoC stage and into the business. Sometimes you’ll even build them yourself. We judge our work by the value it creates for the client. If a solution isn’t moving the numbers that matter, we challenge it and keep adjusting until it does, or we stop it. We expect everyone to go deep enough on the technology to test what models can and can’t do and hold their own with architects and engineers.

We work across industries, but we’re investing most in life sciences (pharma in particular) and manufacturing, where we are scaling our industry depth and experience.

What we’re looking for:

• 
Around 5 to 6 years in consulting, at a firm or in-house. Long enough to have structured problem solving in your bones, and to know when to ignore the frameworks or develop something new.

• 
You’ve run workstreams from scoping to delivery, with a team and a client, and you know how to manage upwards on both sides.

• 
You think in business value. You can put a number on what a solution is worth, and you keep pushing until it delivers.

• 
You’re the one who asks the awkward question in the steering committee, and you can back it up.

• 
You’re obsessively curious. You want to understand how things work, and you’ve usually gone down the rabbit hole before anyone asked you to.

• 
You use AI to work faster, but most importantly you still do the thinking yourself.

• 
Experience from life sciences or manufacturing is a clear plus.

• 
Fluent English. Danish is a bonus.

If you come from the build side:

We also want to hear from people who took a different route. If you’re an engineer or data scientist who ended up spending most of your time with the business, and you’ve built agents, data products or prototypes side by side with the people using them, please apply as well!

Why us?

• 
We’re on top of the newest AI tools, and they’re part of how we work and what we deliver. When something better comes out on a Tuesday, we’re using it by Thursday.

• 
Your ideas will be tested hard and either built or put down (nicely, of course).

• 
You’ll work with some of the largest companies in the Nordics on problems where AI changes the numbers.

• 
You’ll help shape our offerings and the methods behind them, especially in life sciences and manufacturing.

• 
You’re in charge of how you work. Work from home when it suits you. What we care about is that you grow and that our clients get results.

• 
We are a small team of ambitious people who like to spend time together both on and off work. We have various social events, we regularly have breakfast or dinner together and enjoy sharing knowledge on new AI tools, travel tips or anything else that we are passionate about.

How to apply:

Send your CV and half a page, or a two-minute video, answering two questions:

• 
Pick a company you know well. Where will AI change its economics most in the next three years, and what would you do first?

• 
What’s something technical you taught yourself, and why?

If you’re from the build side, send a link to something you’ve made and a few lines on what it taught you.

The interviews include a case. You’ll work through a client problem like the ones we see, and show us how you’d get from the question to something that works.

Skip the cover letter. Your answers tell us more.

Location: Hillerød, Denmark

Job category: Global Manufacturing & Supply

Department: Sustainability & Operational Excellence, Drug Delivery Innovation (DDI), Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS)

Your impact begins here

As Circularity Lead, you will make circular design part of everyday product development for the drug delivery de-vices and packaging that support people living with serious chronic diseases. You will turn circularity knowledge into practical guidance, influence development teams and keep products on track against our Circular for Zero strategy. Your work will shape how future products are designed, reduce their environmental footprint and help Global Manufacturing & Supply advance lasting health and a healthier planet together.

What you'll bring

• Practical experience applying sustainability and circularity to products

• Understanding of circular design principles and environmental knowledge you can apply in product development

• Hands-on experience in product design, product development or a closely related environment

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the confidence to reach out proactively across the organization

• The ability to influence development teams so sustainability requirements get the attention and resources they need

• Comfort working with data, including strong practical Excel skills

• A relevant academic background, such as Environmental Engineering, Engineering, Design & Innovation or sustainability-related studies. A relevant commercial background is also considered alongside strong professional experience

• Fluency in written and spoken English

Useful, but not essential:

• Direct circular design experience in a product setting

• Knowledge of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), including carbon footprint calculations and working with specialist LCA colleagues

• Experience with sustainable materials, plastics, recycling, non-fossil plastics or material innovation

• Experience from pharma, medical devices or a comparable product development environment

You are collaborative and proactive, structured and pragmatic, and curious about the latest trends in circularity. Deep expertise matters, but so does your ability to bring people with you.

What you'll do

You will connect circularity knowledge with product development, guiding teams and driving projects that move our sustainability goals forward.

• Ensure a state-of-the-art approach to circular design in drug delivery devices and packaging, tracking market trends and keeping the Circular Design Guideline up to date

• Provide scientific support on circularity, carbon footprint and plastic footprint, and guide project teams in interpreting circularity assessments

• Anchor Circular for Zero targets in DDI projects and drive circularity progress in key projects, including tools, assessments and process deliverables

• Act as Circular for Zero Process Manager, developing sustainability processes and building capabilities through training

• Drive key cross-organizational projects and share success stories that engage colleagues and stakeholders

Who you'll work with

You will join the Sustainability & Operational Excellence team within Drug Delivery Innovation (DDI), reporting to the Associate Director of Sustainability & Operational Excellence. The team drives and guides sustainability across all DDI areas through capability building, project support and clear communication, and is also responsible for integrating lean principles across DDI.

Your closest partners will be DDI project and programme managers, product developers, designers and engineers as well as commercial colleagues and environmental leads and experts in HQ.

Based in Hillerød, you will work with key stakeholders in Denmark across functions and organizational levels, creating clarity and momentum where circular design meets product development.

What you can expect here

You will work in a collaborative environment where your expertise shapes how future products are designed and made. You can broaden your perspective across the value chain, build new skills and take ownership of complex challenges that often have no precedent.

You will be trusted to make your voice heard and support to perform at your best, as part of a team that combines curiosity, collaboration and ambition to create meaningful progress.

What we offer

At Novo, you will join a global healthcare company with a distinctive culture and a strong track record. We offer continuous learning, career development and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 742,600 to DKK 1,091,600, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The compensation package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives, together with other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring circular design to life in the products that support people living with serious chronic diseases, apply for the Circularity Lead role by 19th November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Nanja Hedal Kløverpris, Assoc Director, Sustainability & Operational Excellence, at nnhk@novonordisk.com.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The OTC Supervisor leads the Order-to-Cash team and owns the quality, speed and control of our cash application, collections and reconciliation processes. The role has a special focus on reconciling card payments and delivery platform settlements across a high-volume, multi-location F&B business. You lead and develop the team, safeguard accurate month-end close deliverables, and drive standardisation and automation of OTC processes in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. The role reports to the Global OTC Manager.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**_People and team leadership

_

• Lead, coach and develop the OTC team, plan workload and the close calendar, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery

_Reconciliation and cash application

_

• Own the daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation of card acquirer, payment provider and delivery platform settlements against POS data, bank and the general ledger

• Ensure differences, chargebacks, fees and missing settlements are resolved, including follow-up with external partners

• Ensure correct cash application, customer and franchise/B2B invoicing, collections and aged debt follow-up in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

_Close, control and reporting

_

• Support month-end close through AR and line of credit reconciliations and review of the allowance for doubtful accounts

• Safeguard internal controls and audit readiness, and report KPIs such as unmatched items and days to cash to management

_Process improvement and collaboration

_

• Drive standardisation, harmonisation and automation of OTC processes across markets

• Partner with Store Operations, Treasury, Accounting, IT and payment and delivery partners, and advise the business on OTC topics

• Act as a key member of cross-functional teams to improve the flow of data and reporting

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• You take ownership of your workload, manage moderately complex tasks, and help improve processes

• You work independently, propose solutions, and adapt quickly when priorities shift

• Your solid knowledge makes you a dependable contributor who helps drive team performance

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• +6 years in Order-to-Cash, accounts receivable or revenue accounting, incl. team lead experience

• Experience from retail, F&B, restaurant or hospitality with many locations

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

• Proven experience reconciling card payments (e.g. Adyen, Nets/Nexi, Worldline) and delivery platforms (e.g. Wolt, Uber Eats, Just Eat) to POS, bank and GL

• Strong accounting, process and Excel skills; degree in finance, accounting or business administration

• Fluent English (Danish is an advantage)

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

Employment type: Full-Time

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. Internally, our agents give colleagues across PEAK Wind a well-governed way to work with company knowledge, generate reports, and analyse wind farm performance. Other internal agents help our own engineers specify and build new features faster. Externally, we provide agent-driven capabilities in our client-facing products.

On smaller initiatives you may be the engineer primarily responsible for taking the solution from first conversation to deployment. On larger initiatives, you will work closely with Product Owners, data engineers, and domain experts in asset management. Either way, the distance from an idea to something running is deliberately short. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Co-develop and maintain the PEAK Wind AI roadmap with the AI team, turning business needs into scoped, sequenced deliverables

• Design, build, and deploy agentic systems for internal colleagues, from reporting and wind farm analysis to engineering-productivity agents

• Design, build, and deploy AI-driven features and agents in our client-facing products, working with SCADA, operations, and asset management data

• Orchestrate multi-agent workflows: tool use, memory, retrieval over company and client data, and integration with our platform through APIs

• Build the evaluation systems that tell us whether an agent works, before and after it reaches production

• Own the data and infrastructure work behind your own agents on the cloud.

• Implement responsible-AI practices for operational energy data: access control, data isolation between clients, logging, and guardrails

• Ship early and iterate put prototypes in users’ hands fast and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

• Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to understand what they need, and push back when AI is not the right tool

• Document what you build so others can maintain, extend, and trust it

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Hands-on experience in software development, ML, data engineering, or AI Engineering, including AI applications you have helped take into production

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building or extending evals for LLM and agent behaviour, or an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• You code with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a matter of course

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• A go-doer mentality: you would rather ship something real this week and improve it next week than perfect it in a document

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative, including owning a product from idea to delivery

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.
